name: Titan
description: The most dominant and beloved roller coaster at Six Flags Over Texas — Titan is a spectacular Morgan hyper coaster reaching 174 km/h down a breathtaking 68-metre first drop through a dramatic layout of helices, speed hills and banking turns. One of the tallest and fastest roller coasters in Texas and a must-ride at any Arlington theme park visit. Min 137cm.

name: Mr. Freeze: Reverse Blast
description: A legendary launched coaster at Six Flags Over Texas launching riders backwards at 96 km/h through a spectacular twisted layout and a towering vertical spike. One of the most intense and unique launched coasters in Texas. Min 137cm.

name: Shockwave
description: A classic and beloved stand-up loop coaster at Six Flags Over Texas delivering one of the largest loops of any stand-up coaster in the world. A beloved Texas coaster institution since 1978 and one of the most historically significant coasters in the Lone Star State. Min 137cm.

name: Batman The Ride
description: A classic and beloved Batman-themed inverted coaster at Six Flags Over Texas delivering five inversions at 80 km/h through a spectacular themed layout. One of the most popular and rerideable inverted coasters in the Dallas-Fort Worth area. Min 137cm.

name: The Joker
description: A spectacular free-fly coaster at Six Flags Over Texas where seats rotate independently through a twisted layout. A uniquely disorienting and entertaining coaster experience in Arlington. Min 122cm.

name: Tormenta
description: A spectacular new-generation spinning coaster at Six Flags Over Texas delivering intense spinning through dramatic banking turns and drops. One of the newest and most exciting additions to the Texas coaster lineup. Min 122cm.

name: Superman Tower of Power
description: A terrifying open-air drop tower at Six Flags Over Texas lifting riders to the top before plunging them back down at terrifying speed with extraordinary views over Arlington and the Dallas-Fort Worth skyline. Min 122cm.

name: Texas SkyScreamer
description: The tallest swing ride in the world at Six Flags Over Texas — Texas SkyScreamer lifts riders 122 metres above the ground for breathtaking panoramic views over Arlington, Dallas and Fort Worth. The most scenic attraction at any Texas theme park. Min 122cm.

name: Pandemonium
description: A fun and popular spinning wild mouse coaster at Six Flags Over Texas with freely rotating cars through tight turns and drops. A fun unpredictable family experience. Min 107cm.

name: Runaway Mine Train
description: A classic and beloved mine train coaster at Six Flags Over Texas and one of the most charming and historically significant family coasters in the Dallas-Fort Worth area. The Runaway Mine Train has been thrilling Texas families since 1966. Min 107cm.

name: Judge Roy Scream
description: A beloved classic wooden roller coaster at Six Flags Over Texas and one of the most charming and entertaining wooden coasters in Texas. Judge Roy Scream has been delighting Dallas-Fort Worth families since 1980. Min 107cm.

name: Oil Derrick
description: A classic observation tower at Six Flags Over Texas offering spectacular panoramic views over Arlington and the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex. One of the most scenic and photogenic attractions at any Texas theme park. Suitable for all ages.

name: Looney Tunes USA
description: A beloved and extensively themed Looney Tunes children and family area at Six Flags Over Texas featuring Bugs Bunny, Tweety Bird, Daffy Duck and friends across multiple family rides, shows and character meet-and-greets. Suitable for all ages.

name: Yosemite Sam's Gold River Adventure
description: A beloved classic dark boat ride at Six Flags Over Texas featuring Yosemite Sam and Bugs Bunny through a fun Western-themed adventure. A beloved park classic and one of the most charming dark rides at any Texas theme park. Suitable for all ages.

name: Anti-Gravity
description: A thrilling spinning flat ride at Six Flags Over Texas delivering wild spinning rotations at high speed. One of the most intense flat rides in the Dallas-Fort Worth area. Min 107cm.
